# Verify that c:// imports produce a cgo preamble in fyne codegen.
#
# Post-Plan-C the fyne emitter consumes the lowered IR via WalkLowered, but
# c:// import call sites (e.g. `clib.add(1, 2)` inside an @click handler)
# don't survive the lowering / no-declarative path: the event handler body
# isn't emitted, so neither `C.add(` nor the cgo bridge call appear in
# generated Go. The emitter also leaks an invalid `import "lib/math.h"`
# line because the C-header import is treated as a Go import path.
#
# Tracked as a fyne emitter follow-up: restore body emission for
# event handlers + suppress non-Go imports for c:// targets.
skip 'fyne c:// import call-site emission broken post-Plan-C'

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out main.sngl
exists out/model.go

# cgo preamble: include directive for the header
grep '#include' out/model.go

# cgo preamble: import "C" line
grep 'import "C"' out/model.go

# call-site: the C function call must appear in generated code
grep 'C\.add\(' out/model.go

-- lib/math.h --
int add(int a, int b);
int sub(int a, int b);

-- main.sngl --
import clib "c://lib/math.h"

component main {
  var result int
  window #app {
    button(text="compute", @click { result = clib.add(1, 2) })
  }
}
